title: The Holy Grail as a technology of regeneration

tellings.quote: I think I'll put it this way. I think it's a technology.

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher into ancient history and lost knowledge, told podcast host Jesse Michels that the Holy Grail of medieval European legend, described in tales by writers such as Chrétien de Troyes, Robert de Boron and Wolfram von Eschenbach in his poem Parzival, was not just a cup or a symbol. "I think it's a technology," he says, one meant for regeneration and healing. If so, the old stories would be memories of a real lost device.
